en: The Fisher Stair: The Last of the Low Town
A wet, plated thing the size of a hound that climbs sheer stone as easily as sand. It goes for the hand-line, not the hands, as if it knows the rope is what keeps people alive.
A gull-shaped hole in the rain, edged with a cold cyan shimmer. It dives at anything that moves fast, and nothing on the wall moves faster than a hauled rope.
A spawn-polyp rooted in the carved faces of the Watchers' stones. It cannot move, so it mends whatever climbs past it. Burning it off scars the carving underneath.
Not a creature. A limb of the storm itself, a column of black water and cloud that closes on the wall-head like a hand. Its wounds bleed cyan, and they do not matter to it.
Each turn of the Fisher Stair brings a group of climbers up. Spawn that grip the stair push it back: hold it on a shield.
Liss can haul the stair to speed the climb, but the Squall Wings dive a hauled rope.
The Kirru on the parapet draws one spawn off with every call. Only the party can burn the rooted polyp.
The storm's hand is closing on the stair. Hold it on a shield.
The climbers can't see the stair. Call on Virel to light it.
Nothing can touch it. Get the last of them up.
The last of them are up.
Toma holds the stair. He will not leave it to strike.
